$comment: Third-party hosts the reference-link check skips, each with the reason. Every other link a lab cites outside learn.microsoft.com is requested by check-accuracy.mjs. Add a host here only after requesting it yourself and finding that a check cannot say anything about the page the lab points at: a product portal that serves the same sign-in shell for every path, a sign-in or API endpoint, or a reserved placeholder. Never add a host just because its link is broken; fix the lab instead. URLs inside code blocks and inline code are never checked, because they are values to type rather than references. A host is either an exact name or *.suffix, which matches any subdomain of suffix but not suffix itself.

skip.reason: Power Platform admin center, behind sign-in. An unauthenticated request gets the sign-in app shell (HTTP 200) for any path, so a check cannot tell a valid deep link from a stale one.
